subject: Request: pilot runway acceleration + engineering grant for Novapulse evaluation
messages:
From: Bethany Cho <bethany@novapulse.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot runway and engineering support request

Soojin —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding this week. We ran into a blocker with our data ingestion pipeline: the engineering team found a mismatch in the column schema from our analytics exports, and it will take us ~2–3 weeks to get the ingest adapters hardened.

We really want to finish the time-boxed pilot and evaluate latency/cost tradeoffs for the production plan, but given the integration slip, would Redwood consider either: 
- a 3-week extension to the pilot window at no charge, or
- a one-time engineering credit (we were thinking ~$15,000) to cover integration support (we'll use Redwood engineering hours).

We have the SOW draft and the NDA attached (see SOW-draft-20270224.pdf, NDA-signed-Novapulse.pdf). If there is a middle-ground you prefer (partial credit + short extension) we can consider that.

Also attaching a calendar invite for a triage call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Bethany
VP, Product
Novapulse

--
Attachments: SOW-draft-20270224.pdf (application/pdf), NDA-signed-Novapulse.pdf (application/pdf)

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: John Miller <jmiller@novapulse.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway and engineering support request

Bethany —

Really appreciate the heads up and the SOW. Sorry to hear about the ingestion issue — totally understandable. Two pragmatic options from our side that we can put on the table today: 

1) 2-week extension (no charge) + a $5,000 engineering credit to help with troubleshooting sessions and a short pairing window with our infra engineers.

2) 1-week extension + an "acceleration grant": we can offer a one-time 20% credit on any overage tokens consumed during the extended week and provide a prioritized sync with our runtime team (up to 8 hours).

Option 1 is cleaner from a legal/procurement perspective; option 2 reduces the cash/credit we book immediately but gives expedited support. I need a quick approval from Finance/Product Ops to issue the $5k credit (if we go with option 1).

If either option works, I'll loop in my manager for sign-off and get a short amendment drafted (small SOW addendum + DocuSign). Which would you prefer?

I can also join the triage call tomorrow to speed unblock.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
